articles.summary: BOSTON and TOKYO – November 10, 2026 – OneSpan Inc. (NASDAQ: OSPN) today announced that its FIDO authentication technology has been selected to support an initiative involving participating banks of Japan’s TSUBASA Alliance. Under the initiative, the participating banks will establish a shared authentication infrastructure for use in their mobile personal banking applications.
articles.title: OneSpan’s FIDO Authentication Technology to Support Japan's TSUBASA Alliance Banking Security Initiative
